content: Data: We use two standard datasets (see Table 4): (1) Freebase FB15k, and (2) WordNet INLINEFORM0 . Using each dataset, we build a fairly large graph and use it as the original KB ( INLINEFORM1 ) for evaluation. We also augment INLINEFORM2 with inverse triples ( INLINEFORM3 , INLINEFORM4 , INLINEFORM5 ) for each ( INLINEFORM6 , INLINEFORM7 , INLINEFORM8 ) following existing KBC methods.
